description: Voices Ania Studio can narrate with, with language (pt-BR, en-US) and gender (Kokoro Alex is the default; if a voice fails the video is narrated by Nanda instead). Each voice has `amostra`: a ~6 s pre-recorded sample (mp3 link) to let the user hear it before choosing. Pass the id to studio_criar_projeto. Free.

language.description: The user's language as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'). Replies and prices follow it.
